The '''manager''' (Japanese: '''マネージャー''' ''manager'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[SM113|This Magik Moment!]]''. She is the manager of the Pokémon actor {{p|Gyarados|Karpy}}.

Karpy's manager first appeared to reprimand {{Rotom}} for taking unauthorized pictures of her client at {{an|Kiawe}}'s request. After several failed takes due to his suddenly deepened voice, Karpy's manager carted him off to a small aquarium so he could take a break. However, during the shoot right after the break, Karpy [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Gyarados}}, causing it to flee in a panic with his manager, {{Ash}}, {{an|Sophocles}}, and Kiawe giving chase.

Karpy's manager was later seen watching him portray the main monster of a {{wp|kaiju}} film.

|desc='''Karpy''' (Japanese: '''コイちゃん''' ''Koi-chan'') is the Manager's only known Pokémon. He is a famous {{p|Magikarp}} child acting prodigy, and the star of a popular drama Little Magikarp's Melody. While filming a dramatic farewell scene, Karpy's trademark high-pitched voice began to drop, and he began glowing. After several attempts to resist, he [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{p|Gyarados}}.

Shocked by the turn of events, he fled to the [[Alola TV]] station, eventually running into [[George Charino]], who he met when he was much younger. Inspired, George cast Karpy as the villain of the action show The Refreshing Trio: Alola Idols. The shoot was a success, and Karpy found a new niche for himself in villainous roles.

Karpy's known moves are {{m|Splash}}, {{m|Hydro Pump}}, and {{m|Hyper Beam}}.}}
